controller.recipe: frozen B2: theta0 block-18 last-token rep (1024) + step_norm -> L2 logistic (Newton)
controller.fit_on: ALL 686 V1 seed1/2/3 valid groups (rollout history only; no reward/verifier input)

C_selection.criterion: mean inner family-grouped AUPRC over 4 folds

controller.standardization: mean/std of the 686-group fit set, stored with the weights
controller.step_feature_semantics: step_norm = elapsed optimizer updates / 60, identical to the D001 feature; a <=30-step trial stays inside the fitted support

step_sensitivity.note: step_norm is 1 of 1025 features; the q(t) surface is nearly flat, so the frozen sampler is effectively time-stationary inside a <=30-step trial

controller.scope_note: these weights are the deployment controller fit on V1 history; they are NOT a substitute for the OOF predictions used to freeze (alpha, epsilon)

sampler_form: w_i(t) = epsilon + q_i(t)^alpha ;  P(i|t) = w_i / sum_j w_j  (stochastic, NO deterministic top-k; prompt-pool row multiplicity preserved)

grid_search.objective: maximise the multiplicity-weighted OOF-predicted treated IGR
grid_search.constraint_rationale: anti-collapse constraints are measured RELATIVE TO THE CONTROL ARM's own row-level distribution, because pool row multiplicity (1..54) already makes the uniform control arm concentrate ~4.8x relative to statement-uniform; an absolute cap would grade the pool's copy structure instead of the controller, and would forbid the treatment for doing what the control already does

sensitivity_alternative_objective.objective: maximise the record-level (group-uniform) OOF-predicted treated IGR

forbidden: any reward from a candidate run
any retune after R001 data exists

selected.selection_rule: max multiplicity-weighted OOF-predicted treated IGR among feasible pairs; ties toward the larger epsilon (flatter, safer)
selected.uplift_definition_multiplicity_weighted: treated row-weighted mean minus control row-weighted mean, both over the SAME labelled statements with the same multiplicity weights (coherent contrast)
selected.uplift_definition_record_level: treated mean under w = epsilon + q^alpha minus the equal-weight 686-group mean (the D001 realized prevalence); no multiplicity enters either side
selected.caveat: an off-policy estimate on the 686 V1 groups, not a guarantee: the treated arm also changes which groups are informative as it learns

power_analysis.unit_of_inference: training step (cluster of 4 groups / 32 candidates) - the historical unit
power_analysis.scenario_assumption: the offline OOF-predicted uplift is an UPPER bound for a real trial: it treats informativeness as a fixed property of the theorem and ignores policy drift plus use-up of mixed groups, so 5-26 pp scenarios are all priced in

planned_arms.control: uniform sampler (w identically 1) over the same filtered prompt pool
planned_arms.identical_everywhere_else: model/theta0, n=8, batch, optimizer, LR, GRPO/DrGRPO flags, max response length, temperature, top_p, verifier
